bounty.title: Publish Sourcey docs for a maintained OSS library

build.config: sourcey.config.ts with baseUrl /wakapi-api-docs/, siteUrl https://merioneeason.github.io, tabs Guide (markdown) + API Reference (openapi)

observations: Repo https://github.com/muety/wakapi is MIT-licensed (LICENSE file head reads 'The MIT License (MIT)'; GitHub API license spdx_id MIT), last push 2026-11-08, 4473 stars.
Pinned commit c561bbc174d139d2d3f8ee222ca61671cdc3caf1 (2026-11-08). The spec file downloaded at that commit is byte-identical to the spec used for the build (diff clean).
Sourcey 3.9.5 build output: 'API Reference: Published as one page: 22 operations and 817 field rows. Pages: 5.' Output 122 files.
All 22 operations from the spec appear in api.html (verified by summary text: 'Retrieve a summary', 'Push a new heartbeat', '/heartbeat', '/compat/wakatime/v1/users', 'WakaTime', 'Authorization').
Guide pages index.html, authentication.html, heartbeats.html exist and interlink; index.html cites the pinned commit.
All 280 internal links in api.html carry the /wakapi-api-docs/ base path (config baseUrl), so the site works under a GitHub Pages project subpath.
Local HTTP check: python http.server served the built site; / and /api.html returned HTTP 200 with the expected content.

Governed run: runx skill ./skill --run-id wakapi-sourcey-docs-1 returned status sealed, outcome completed, receipt_id sha256:4dd035ca05cbb0e35ed42dfb2f244390e79990e1d2a9a9e31f472469bfc0fff5, result operations 22 / pages 5 / site_files 122 / sourcey_version 3.9.5.
runx verify on the receipt id returned valid true, receipt_count 2, findings [].
wakapi.dev/api returns HTTP 404 — no public API reference page exists on the project's own site; the only reference material that ships is the raw spec file in the repo.

Known gap / hosting caveat: the public URL is a personal GitHub Pages project site (merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/), not a project/maintainer domain. The repo includes the full Sourcey project (sourcey.config.ts, spec, guides) plus adoption instructions so the Wakapi maintainer can host the same site on wakapi.dev. This is disclosed, not hidden.

Spec quality gaps documented in the report: spec info.license says GPL-3.0 while the repo is MIT; spec has no host/basePath/schemes; only 2 example values across 22 operations; five overlapping heartbeat POST routes with numbered operationIds (post-heartbeat-2..8) and no usage guidance.
summary: Sourcey-generated public API reference for Wakapi (muety/wakapi, MIT), built from the OpenAPI spec shipped in the repository at pinned commit c561bbc174d139d2d3f8ee222ca61671cdc3caf1. 22/22 operations documented plus a 3-page getting-started guide. Published at https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/ (GitHub Pages project site; maintainer adoption on wakapi.dev is offered in the repo README — see known gaps). Governed run sealed with runx CLI 0.11.1; receipt verified locally.

target.license: MIT (repo LICENSE file and GitHub API agree; note the spec's info.license field incorrectly says GPL-3.0 — see report)
